args.command: echo "A http-outside:"; wget -S -O- -T 8 http://example.com 2>&1 | head -6; echo "B https-outside:"; wget -S -O- -T 8 https://example.com 2>&1 | head -6; echo "C dns-outside:"; nslookup example.com 2>&1 | tail -5; echo "D dns-allowed:"; nslookup mock-llm.kagent.svc.cluster.local 2>&1 | tail -4; echo "E allowed-host:"; wget -q -O- -T 8 http://mock-llm.kagent.svc.cluster.local:8080/v1/models 2>&1 | head -3; echo; echo "F raw-ip:"; wget -O- -T 5 http://1.1.1.1 2>&1 | head -3; echo "G kube-api:"; wget -O- -T 5 --no-check-certificate https://kubernetes.default.svc.cluster.local 2>&1 | head -3; echo "H short-name:"; wget -q -O- -T 5 http://mock-llm.kagent:8080/v1/models 2>&1 | head -3; echo; echo "I resolv:"; cat /etc/resolv.conf; ip addr 2>&1 | grep -E 'inet |^[0-9]' | head -8; ip route 2>&1 | head
